correctness.rationale: The free-tail recurrence and both bond equations reduce exactly to (1-c²r²)²=(c²−1)²r^(2d+4). A strictly decreasing first polynomial has one root; an increasing H_d(r)=r²(1+...+r^(d−1))/(1+r) gives the sharp second-root criterion d(c²−1)>2. The two decaying tails construct and exhaust all outlier eigenvalues. The bipartite symmetry gives negative partners, spectral rotation and the positive top eigenvector give a closed numerical disk, and a fixed-c Taylor expansion gives the tunneling coefficient. The included standard-library checker replays 4498 finite exact rational and eigenvector-matching assertions; infinite claims rest on the analytic proof.

value.rationale: Two isolated enhanced hopping bonds constitute the minimal natural pair of off-diagonal impurities. The exact contrast-versus-distance threshold determines whether a second localized mode exists, while the closed numerical range and the exact exponentially small tunneling coefficient quantify competing global and local spectral effects. The onset is not a normalization check or a preassigned low-dimensional slice; it is a complete all-distance, all-contrast classification.
